attachments.origin_landmark: anterior surface of the distal femoral shaft, deep to vastus intermedius
attachments.insertion_landmark: synovial membrane of the suprapatellar bursa (the patella is the nearest schema bone; the schema takes a bone id; the true attachment is cartilage/skin and is named in the landmark text)

actions: pulls the suprapatellar bursa (synovial membrane) proximally during knee extension so it is not trapped between patella and femur

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

fiber_architecture.evidence: no measured architecture recorded: no PCSA, fascicle length or force verified from a source for this muscle (Q65 rule: numbers only where a source gives them)

functional_compartments.function_note: A few small slips deep to vastus intermedius, often fused with it; relevant to suprapatellar effusion assessment and to the quadriceps injection site above the patella.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
